subject.title: Add Tailscale Serve support for WSL gateways

question: Should verified Tailscale identity and tailnet ACLs be an optional gateway authorization path for generated WSL gateways alongside existing token and device credentials?
rationale: The broad gateway-user operator delegation has been removed, but allowing credential-free authentication through tailnet identity remains a durable security and product contract that automated review cannot approve.

options.title: Allow explicit identity trust
options.body: Accept the separately enabled identity path while preserving token and device authentication and root-owned Tailscale lifecycle controls, contingent on exact-head live proof.

options.title: Ship transport only
options.body: Land private Tailscale Serve connectivity but keep gateway authentication limited to existing token and device credentials.

options.title: Pause identity support
options.body: Defer the PR until maintainers establish a different identity-lookup or authorization boundary.

recommendation.title: Allow explicit identity trust
recommendation.body: Accept the separately enabled identity path while preserving token and device authentication and root-owned Tailscale lifecycle controls, contingent on exact-head live proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This account supplied the most detailed review of the permanent Tailscale privilege and authentication contract.
